mapper.update: update pub_publog set delflag_ = 0 where pid = #{pid}
mapper.select: select pub_file_name as pubFileName, pub_subject as pubSubject, CREATED_BY_NAME_ as createByName, ARCH_DATE as archDate from pub_publog where status = '1'

select * from ( select
from pub_publog where delflag_ = '1'
and arch_date like #{param.year} || '%'
and ( to_char(arch_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') like '%' || #{param.begin} || '%' or to_char(arch_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') like '%' || #{param.center} || '%' or to_char(arch_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') like '%' || #{param.end} || '%' )
and to_char(arch_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') like '%' || #{param.month} || '%'
order by created_time_ desc )
